fact: BCEAO Instruction N°001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024 on payment services requires fintechs to obtain a BCEAO licence by 31 August 2025; as of 27 May 2025, 4 of 11 licensed institutions were in Côte d'Ivoire.
title: Instruction N°001-01-2024 BCEAO : Les fintech ont jusqu'au 31 août 2025 pour obtenir un agrément de la BCEAO
